title: Inverse outside a valuation ring lies in its maximal ideal
statement: Let $F$ be a field [def-weil-field] and let $A\subseteq F$ be a valuation subring, meaning a subring such that for every $x\in F^\times$ either $x\in A$ or $x^{-1}\in A$. Write $A^\times=\{u\in A\setminus\{0\}:u^{-1}\in A\}$ and $\mathfrak m_A=A\setminus A^\times$. For every $x\in F$, with $0^{-1}=0$, one has $x^{-1}\in\mathfrak m_A$ if and only if $x=0$ or $x\notin A$.
